label: preparing
what: Possibly a private social gathering or appreciation occasion for me in the great hall, presented as a lighting inspection. The innkeeper and builder explicitly say they arranged the gathering, insist on accompanying me at eighteen hundred, and the builder asks what improvement makes me proudest of my service. This suggests, but does not establish, a concealed celebratory purpose. I was told about and approved the inspection and escort, so those alone are not secret preparations. The secretary knowingly helps schedule and accompany the inspection, but I have no evidence that the secretary knows any hidden purpose. Reports place baker, freight, innkeeper and neighbour together at the bakery, but do not establish that baker, freight or neighbour participates in this possible occasion. Its precise nature, and any additional knowing helpers, remain unsupported.
